name: BlueBird Kiosk Cache Redirect
description: Redirects Legacy Wall media-image requests from the cloud (bluebird-alerts.com) to the local on-device cache served by bluebird-admin.service at 127.0.0.1:7311. The local server returns cached bytes when present and 302-redirects back to the cloud on cache miss, so the dashboard never breaks even before the sync catches up.
